# Cell 7 — Clean layer (signerade belopp + pris/värde-koll)

import numpy as np

dfc = df.copy()

# 1) Signera BUY/SELL så summeringar blir korrekta
dfc["signed_volume"] = np.where(dfc["transaction_type"].eq("SELL"), -dfc["volume"], dfc["volume"])
dfc["signed_value"]  = np.where(dfc["transaction_type"].eq("SELL"), -dfc["transaction_value"], dfc["transaction_value"])

# 2) Enhetskontroll: implied price från value/volume (ska matcha price_per_share om enheter är rätt)
dfc["implied_price"] = np.where(dfc["volume"] != 0, dfc["transaction_value"] / dfc["volume"], np.nan)

# Snabb jämförelse av nivåer och extrema värden
check = dfc[["price_per_share","implied_price"]].describe(percentiles=[.01,.05,.5,.95,.99]).T
check

# Cell 9 — Hitta instrument-kolumn + bygg holdings (position i units)

import re
import numpy as np

# 1) Lista kolumner (snabb debug)
cols = dfc.columns.tolist()
print("Kolumner i dfc:", cols)

# 2) Leta efter rimliga instrument-identifierare (vanliga namn i finansdata)
candidates = [
    "instrument_id", "instrument", "instrument_name",
    "ticker", "symbol", "isin", "cusip", "sedol",
    "security_id", "security", "asset_id", "asset",
    "company_id", "company", "company_name",
    "name", "stock", "stock_name"
]

existing = [c for c in candidates if c in dfc.columns]

# 3) Extra: hitta “troliga” kolumner via mönster i kolumnnamn
pattern_hits = [c for c in dfc.columns if re.search(r"(isin|ticker|symbol|instrument|security|asset|company|name)", c, re.I)]

print("\nBefintliga kandidater (exakt match):", existing)
print("Troliga kolumner (pattern match):", pattern_hits)

# 4) Välj key automatiskt (först bästa match), annars stoppa med tydligt meddelande
if len(existing) > 0:
    key = existing[0]
elif len(pattern_hits) > 0:
    key = pattern_hits[0]
else:
    raise ValueError(
        "Hittar ingen tydlig instrument-kolumn (t.ex. ticker/isin/instrument/company). "
        "Välj en kolumn i listan ovan som identifierar värdepappret och sätt key = 'DIN_KOLUMN'."
    )

print("\nVald instrumentnyckel (key):", key)

# 5) Bygg holdings över tid
dfc = dfc.sort_values(["timestamp", key])
dfc["position_units"] = dfc.groupby(key)["signed_volume"].cumsum()

# 6) Sanity-check: topp 10 största slutpositioner
top_pos = (dfc.groupby(key)["position_units"].last()
           .abs()
           .sort_values(ascending=False)
           .head(10))

top_pos

# Cell 11 — Kontroll: stämmer transaction_value ≈ price_per_share * volume?

dfc["expected_value"] = dfc["price_per_share"] * dfc["volume"]

# Relativt fel (hantera nollor)
dfc["rel_error"] = np.where(
    dfc["transaction_value"] != 0,
    (dfc["transaction_value"] - dfc["expected_value"]) / dfc["transaction_value"],
    np.nan
)

# Sammanfattning
summary_err = dfc["rel_error"].describe(percentiles=[.01,.05,.5,.95,.99])
print(summary_err)

# Cell 18 (REPLACE) — Bygg dagliga positioner (units) från trades (BUY/SELL)

trades = dfc[dfc["transaction_type"].isin(["BUY","SELL"])].copy()

# Dagliga flöden i units
flow = (trades.groupby(["date","instrument"], as_index=False)
        .agg(daily_net_units=("signed_volume","sum")))

# Komplett datumgrid baserat på daily (alla datum x instrument)
grid = daily[["date","instrument"]].drop_duplicates()

pos = (grid.merge(flow, on=["date","instrument"], how="left")
       .sort_values(["instrument","date"]))

pos["daily_net_units"] = pos["daily_net_units"].fillna(0.0)
pos["position_units"] = pos.groupby("instrument")["daily_net_units"].cumsum()

print("Pos shape:", pos.shape)
pos.head(5)

# Cell 19 (REPLACE) — Merge daily + positions (utan namn-krock) + market value + vikter

# Byt namn på pos-kolumnen innan merge för att undvika suffix-krockar
pos2 = pos[["date","instrument","position_units"]].rename(columns={"position_units": "position_units_pos"})

panel = (daily.merge(pos2, on=["date","instrument"], how="left")
         .sort_values(["instrument","date"]))

panel["position_units"] = panel["position_units_pos"].fillna(0.0)
panel = panel.drop(columns=["position_units_pos"])

# Market value (presentation-enhet)
panel["market_value"] = panel["position_units"] * panel["price"]

# Portföljens totala market value per dag
port_mv = panel.groupby("date", as_index=False)["market_value"].sum().rename(columns={"market_value":"portfolio_mv"})
panel = panel.merge(port_mv, on="date", how="left")

# Vikter
panel["weight"] = np.where(panel["portfolio_mv"] != 0, panel["market_value"] / panel["portfolio_mv"], 0.0)

print("Panel shape:", panel.shape)

# Cell 20 (REPLACE) — Portföljreturn via P&L / Gross Exposure
# Stabilt även om portfolio_mv blir nära 0 eller negativt (net short / netto-noll).
# Return_t = sum(pos_{t-1} * (P_t - P_{t-1})) / sum(|pos_{t-1} * P_{t-1}|)

panel = panel.sort_values(["instrument", "date"]).copy()

panel["price_lag"] = panel.groupby("instrument")["price"].shift(1)
panel["pos_lag"] = panel.groupby("instrument")["position_units"].shift(1).fillna(0.0)

panel["pnl"] = panel["pos_lag"] * (panel["price"] - panel["price_lag"])
panel["gross_exposure"] = (panel["pos_lag"] * panel["price_lag"]).abs()

port_ret = (panel.groupby("date", as_index=False)
            .agg(pnl=("pnl","sum"),
                 gross_exposure=("gross_exposure","sum")))

port_ret["portfolio_return"] = np.where(
    port_ret["gross_exposure"] > 0,
    port_ret["pnl"] / port_ret["gross_exposure"],
    0.0
)

port_ret["equity"] = (1 + port_ret["portfolio_return"].fillna(0.0)).cumprod()

# Cell 26 — Risk summary long-only + jämförelse

def risk_pack(df_returns):
    r = df_returns["portfolio_return"].dropna()
    var95 = float(np.quantile(r, 0.05))
    vol_d = float(r.std())
    vol_a = float(vol_d * np.sqrt(252))

    eq = df_returns["equity"].ffill()
    dd = eq/eq.cummax() - 1
    mdd = float(dd.min())

    return {"VaR_95": var95, "Vol_daily": vol_d, "Vol_ann": vol_a, "MaxDD": mdd, "Days": int(len(r))}

print("ORIGINAL (kan innehålla short):", risk_pack(port_ret))
print("LONG-ONLY (bank-demo):", risk_pack(port_ret_long))

# Cell 33 — Clean daily price (BUY/SELL) + forward-fill per instrument

# 1) dagligt pris från trades (sista trade per dag)
trade_price = (trades.sort_values(["date","timestamp"])
               .groupby(["date","instrument"], as_index=False)
               .last()[["date","instrument","price","currency","company_name","sector","risk_rating","analyst_rating","esg_score","credit_rating","var_95","liquidity_score","spread_pct"]])

# 2) global kalender (datasetet har även helgdagar, så freq="D")
cal = pd.date_range(dfc["date"].min(), dfc["date"].max(), freq="D")

# 3) reindex + ffill pris per instrument
clean_list = []
for inst, g in trade_price.groupby("instrument"):
    g = g.set_index("date").sort_index()
    g = g.reindex(cal)
    g["instrument"] = inst
    
    # forward-fill pris + metadata (fyller bara framåt)
    for col in ["price","currency","company_name","sector","risk_rating","analyst_rating","esg_score","credit_rating","var_95","liquidity_score","spread_pct"]:
        g[col] = g[col].ffill()
    
    g = g.reset_index().rename(columns={"index":"date"})
    clean_list.append(g)

daily_clean = pd.concat(clean_list, ignore_index=True)
print("daily_clean shape:", daily_clean.shape)

# Cell 34 — Clean positions på kalendern + long-only returns (P&L / gross exposure)

# Dagliga flöden i units (BUY/SELL)
flow = (trades.groupby(["date","instrument"], as_index=False)
        .agg(daily_net_units=("signed_volume","sum")))

# Grid = alla datum i kalendern x instrument
grid = daily_clean[["date","instrument"]].drop_duplicates()

pos_clean = (grid.merge(flow, on=["date","instrument"], how="left")
             .sort_values(["instrument","date"]))
pos_clean["daily_net_units"] = pos_clean["daily_net_units"].fillna(0.0)
pos_clean["position_units"] = pos_clean.groupby("instrument")["daily_net_units"].cumsum()

# Merge price + position
panel_clean = (daily_clean.merge(pos_clean[["date","instrument","position_units"]], on=["date","instrument"], how="left")
               .sort_values(["instrument","date"]))

panel_clean["position_units"] = panel_clean["position_units"].fillna(0.0)

# Lagg
panel_clean["price_lag"] = panel_clean.groupby("instrument")["price"].shift(1)
panel_clean["pos_lag"] = panel_clean.groupby("instrument")["position_units"].shift(1).fillna(0.0)

# Long-only
panel_clean["pos_lag_longonly"] = panel_clean["pos_lag"].clip(lower=0)

# PnL / gross exposure
panel_clean["pnl_longonly"] = panel_clean["pos_lag_longonly"] * (panel_clean["price"] - panel_clean["price_lag"])
panel_clean["gross_exp_longonly"] = (panel_clean["pos_lag_longonly"] * panel_clean["price_lag"]).abs()

port_ret_long_clean = (panel_clean.groupby("date", as_index=False)
                       .agg(pnl=("pnl_longonly","sum"),
                            gross_exposure=("gross_exp_longonly","sum")))

port_ret_long_clean["portfolio_return"] = np.where(
    port_ret_long_clean["gross_exposure"] > 0,
    port_ret_long_clean["pnl"] / port_ret_long_clean["gross_exposure"],
    0.0
)

                  .sort_values("market_value", ascending=False))

# Cell 49 — Bootstrap CI per analyst_rating (95% CI för mean)

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

def bootstrap_mean_ci(x, n_boot=2000, alpha=0.05):
    x = np.asarray(x)
    x = x[~np.isnan(x)]
    if len(x) < 30:
        return (np.nan, np.nan)  # för få obs, markera
    boots = rng.choice(x, size=(n_boot, len(x)), replace=True).mean(axis=1)
    lo = np.quantile(boots, alpha/2)
    hi = np.quantile(boots, 1 - alpha/2)
    return (float(lo), float(hi))

ci_rows = []
for rating, g in sig.groupby("analyst_rating"):
    lo, hi = bootstrap_mean_ci(g["ret_1d_next"].values)
    ci_rows.append({"analyst_rating": rating, "ci_lo": lo, "ci_hi": hi, "n": int(len(g))})

ci = pd.DataFrame(ci_rows).merge(grp.reset_index(), on=["analyst_rating","n"], how="left")
ci = ci.sort_values("n", ascending=False)

# Spara till report/
ci.to_csv("report/analyst_rating_signal_summary.csv", index=False)

# Cell 51 — Regression: next-day return ~ C(analyst_rating) + kontroller (robust SE)
# Om statsmodels saknas, säger cellen till.

try:
    import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
    
    reg_df = sig.dropna(subset=["ret_1d_next","analyst_rating","spread_pct","liquidity_score","esg_score","var_95"]).copy()

    # Enkel modell: rating-effekt + cost-of-risk kontroller (du kan lägga till sector fixed effects senare)
    model = smf.ols("ret_1d_next ~ C(analyst_rating) + spread_pct + liquidity_score + esg_score + var_95", data=reg_df).fit(cov_type="HC3")
    print(model.summary())
    
except Exception as e:
    print("Statsmodels-regression kunde inte köras:", e)
    print("Du kan installera statsmodels med: pip install statsmodels")

# Cell 52 (REPLACE) — Cost of risk segmenttabell (SEK) från daily_full (inkl sharpe_ratio)

# 1) Bygg daily_full från dfc (sista observation per dag & instrument, med alla kolumner)
daily_full = (dfc.sort_values(["date", "timestamp"])
              .groupby(["date", "instrument"], as_index=False)
              .last())

# 2) SEK-filter
cor = daily_full[daily_full["currency"] == "SEK"].copy()

print("Kolumner i cor (för kontroll):", sorted(cor.columns))

# 3) Aggregera bara på kolumner som faktiskt finns (robust)
agg_map = {
    "instrument": ("instrument", "count"),
    "spread_pct": ("spread_pct", "mean"),
    "liquidity_score": ("liquidity_score", "mean"),
    "var_95": ("var_95", "mean"),
    "sharpe_ratio": ("sharpe_ratio", "mean"),  # finns i dfc -> ska funka här
}

# Ta bort eventuella mått som inte finns (extra-säkerhet)
agg_map = {k: v for k, v in agg_map.items() if v[0] in cor.columns}

seg_cost = (cor.groupby("risk_rating")
            .agg(**{
                "n": agg_map["instrument"],
                "spread_mean": agg_map.get("spread_pct", ("instrument","count")),
                "liq_mean": agg_map.get("liquidity_score", ("instrument","count")),
                "var95_mean": agg_map.get("var_95", ("instrument","count")),
                "sharpe_mean": agg_map.get("sharpe_ratio", ("instrument","count")),
            })
            .sort_values("n", ascending=False))

import numpy as np

# Cell 59 — Ren regression-tabell (HC3) utan summary-varning

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import pandas as pd

reg_df = sig.dropna(subset=["ret_1d_next","analyst_rating","spread_pct","liquidity_score","esg_score","var_95"]).copy()
reg_df["analyst_rating"] = reg_df["analyst_rating"].astype("category").cat.remove_unused_categories()

base = smf.ols(
    "ret_1d_next ~ C(analyst_rating) + spread_pct + liquidity_score + esg_score + var_95",
    data=reg_df
).fit()

rob = base.get_robustcov_results(cov_type="HC3")

coef_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "coef": rob.params,
    "se_HC3": rob.bse,
    "t": rob.tvalues,
    "p": rob.pvalues
}).sort_values("p")

coef_table.to_csv("report/regression_coefficients_HC3.csv", index=True)

# Cell 66 — Skapa README.md (kort och bankigt)

readme = """# Portfolio Risk Report (Clean Long-only Demo)

## What this is
A reproducible portfolio analytics demo built from transaction-like data (BUY/SELL) and daily snapshots.

## Key outputs
- Risk report (HTML): report/portfolio_risk_report.html
- Figures: report/figures/
- Tables: report/*.csv

## Method (high level)
- Clean daily price series built from last BUY/SELL trade per day and forward-filled per instrument.
- Portfolio return computed using P&L / gross exposure (stable when net exposure is near zero).
- Long-only demo portfolio (negative positions clipped to 0).
- Active days only (days with gross exposure > 0) for risk stats.
- Signal test: analyst_rating at day t -> next-day return at t+1 (no leakage).

## How to run
1) Open the notebook
2) Restart Kernel -> Run All
3) Open: report/portfolio_risk_report.html

## Notes
- Currency filter used in some analyses (SEK) to avoid FX mixing.
- This is a demo pipeline; real production setups include FX conversion, transaction costs, corporate actions feed, and governance/validation.
"""

with open("README.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(readme)

print("Skapad: README.md")
